subject.title: [Feature]: add VALUE.md as a first-class workspace context file

question: Should OpenClaw add VALUE.md as a seeded first-class workspace file with documented precedence semantics, or keep value orientation in existing workspace files/custom context mechanisms?
rationale: This changes the core workspace-file model and prompt semantics rather than fixing a broken current contract, and the direct implementation PR was closed as product/design work.

options.title: Defer Core VALUE.md
options.body: Keep the issue open as a design decision and prefer SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, or the arbitrary custom-file track until maintainers sponsor a new core file.

options.title: Approve First-Class VALUE.md
options.body: Accept the new workspace convention and ask for a fresh focused implementation with loader, seeding, Gateway, docs, and tests.

options.title: Fold Into Custom Files
options.body: Treat VALUE.md as a use case for configurable custom bootstrap files instead of a default seeded core file.

recommendation.title: Defer Core VALUE.md
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open as a design decision and prefer SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, or the arbitrary custom-file track until maintainers sponsor a new core file.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the clearest prior maintainer signal by closing the direct VALUE.md PR as product/design work and is also recent current-line owner in the affected workspace surfaces.
